【Fee】Adults ¥5,000, Elementary school and younger ¥4,000 (includes guide, insurance, canoe rental, lunch)

【Capacity】5 people

【Guide】Staff of certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】Drinking water (vending machine available at the workshop). Bring sun protection (hat, sunglasses, etc.) as needed.

【More information】Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
